Click the field to set a standing-stone. Sheep flee a stone, never touch it. Thread the whole flock through the gate into the brass fold.
The quiet correctness layer self-test: …
Determinism.EXACT Same stones + seed + level ⇒ byte-identical run & verdict. A failed run is exactly reproducible — you iterate on placement, not luck. —
No overlap, ever.EXACT minPairSep > 0 every step, even under many stones — a positional barrier, not a soft force. —
WIN ≡ allInFold.EXACT No false win; no timer, no “close enough”. —
Neg-control.EXACT Zero stones ⇒ cohesion alone never threads the bottleneck (both gated levels). The stones are load-bearing. —
MODELED The flock itself runs a believable herding model — Reynolds boids (separation / alignment / cohesion) plus a capped inverse-square flee from each stone. It is not a claim about how real sheep move; it is the same law The Shepherd is built on, here driven by fixed stones instead of a live dog. What is proven exact is the conscience above: determinism, the no-overlap floor, and the win rule.
A placement-puzzle foil to The Shepherd — same verified law, no live steering.
